orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Alok Kumar Verma
orders.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND 
AT NAINITAL
 THE HON’BLE SRI JUSTICE ALOK KUMAR VERMA
29th AUGUST, 2023
CRIMINAL REVISION NO. 609 of 2023
Didar Singh. ..…Revisionist
 Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and Another. .....Respondents
Counsel for the Revisionist : Mr. Girish Chandra 
 Lakhchaura, Advocate
 through video 
 conferencing.
Counsel for the Respondent : Mrs. Manisha Rana 
Singh, A.G.A. 
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.
Proposed Revision has been filed against the 
judgment dated 21.07.2023, passed by learned IIIrd 
Additional District and Sessions Judge, Udham Singh 
Nagar in Criminal Appeal No.425 of 2019, by which, the 
Appeal, filed against the judgment dated 25.11.2019, 
passed by learned Judicial Magistrate Bazpur, District 
Udham Singh Nagar in Complaint Case No.4510 of 2016, 
by which, revisionist was convicted and sentenced to 
undergo simple imprisonment for a period of two years 
along with a fine of Rs. 11,00,000/- for the offence under 
Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, has 
been dismissed. 
2. Mr. Girish Chandra Lakhchaura, Advocate, 
contended that the complaint filed by the complainant was  2
a premature complaint, and during the trial, he could not 
establish the source of money. Therefore, there are 
substantial doubt about the conviction. 
3. Admit. 
4. Issue notice to the respondent no.2-
complainant. 
5. Steps to be taken within a week. 
6. List on 20.10.2023. 
7. Heard on the Bail Application (IA No. 01 of 
2023).
8. Mr. Girish Chandra Lakhchaura, Advocate, 
contended that the revisionist was on bail during the trial 
and appeal, and, the conditions of bail were never misused 
by him. 
9. Considering the facts and circumstances of the 
case, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the revisionist
Didar Singh.
10. Let the revisionist be released on bail on his 
executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable 
sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of 
Trial Court. 
___________________
ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
Dt: 29.08.2023
Neha
